lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi
couplets.en: What will you find in loving me?

lines: Mere haalaat ki aandhi mein bikhar jaaogi
couplets.en: The storm of my life will scatter you.

lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi
couplets.en: What will you find in loving me?

lines: Ranj aur dard ki basti ka main baashinda hoon
couplets.en: I live where grief and pain make their home.

lines: Ye to bas main hoon ki is haal mein bhi zinda hoon
couplets.en: Only I could go on living like this.

lines: Khwaab kyun dekhoon woh kal jis pe main sharminda hoon
couplets.en: Why dream of a tomorrow I am already ashamed of?

lines: Main jo sharminda hua tum bhi to sharmaaogi
couplets.en: If I feel ashamed, you will lower your eyes too.

lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi
couplets.en: What will you find in loving me?

lines: Ek main kya, abhi aaenge deewaane kitne
couplets.en: Who am I, when so many more will fall for you?

lines: Abhi ho jaaenge mohabbat ke taraane kitne
couplets.en: There are so many love songs still to be sung.
Life has so many stories yet to tell you.

lines: Kyun samajhti ho mujhe bhool nahin paaogi
couplets.en: Why do you think you will never forget me?

lines: Pyaar mujhse jo kiya tumne to kya paaogi
couplets.en: What will you find in loving me?
